name: Schaeffler family (Maria-Elisabeth Schaeffler-Thumann and Georg F. W. Schaeffler)
note: The Schaeffler Group company website describes the group as 'predominantly in family ownership', naming Maria-Elisabeth Schaeffler-Thumann (shareholder of the INA-Holding Schaeffler GmbH & Co. KG) and her son Georg F. W. Schaeffler as the shareholders continuing the work of Georg Schaeffler, who died in 1996.
